answer: Someone as a result has to keep every alias continuously active for 21 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The vine counter is kept in ember and harbor shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 21 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 2034 identities would post 3445 proofs and burn roughly 26 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
